exposure: one attending and one resident physician
outcome: Major maternal morbidity (hysterectomy, cystotomy, bowel injury, intensive care unit admission, thrombosis, reoperation, death)
cohort: Patients undergoing a third- or greater order cesarean delivery
finding: Resident participation in high-order cesarean deliveries did not negatively affect patient outcomes compared to procedures performed by two attending physicians.
mod_finding: Resident participation in high-order cesarean deliveries does not negatively affect outcomes.
